It means your time is up.|[[Swamp Monster (Narrator)|Swamp Monster]] dialogue on Wave 11 ([[Foggy Forest]])}}}} __TOC__ ==Description== The '''Werewolf''' was an enemy that appeared in the second and third night of the [[Solar Eclipse Event]]. It had a very high amount of health and an average speed. It had one ability, which increased its speed for a short period of time. This, combined with its high health, made it a dangerous enemy. ==Appearance== The '''Werewolf''' was a large, humanoid wolf with an animalistic face structure. It had dark grey fur and blue neon eyes, and wolf ears. It also had three claws on both of its hands, and had a hunched posture. ==Strategy== *Because of the '''Werewolf's''' fast speed and high health, it is recommended to use a slowing tower, such as the [[Toxic Gunner]], [[Sledger]] or [[Electroshocker]] to slow it down. *High DPS towers, such as the [[Swarmer]], [[Minigunner]] or [[Accelerator]] are recommended against this. **You can use the [[Commander]] to boost their firerate. ==Gallery== {{Gallery| {{GalleryHeader|Trailers}} Tower Defense Simulator- Solar Eclipse Trailer|'''Werewolf''' in the game trailer. {{GalleryHeader|Miscellaneous}} LoupGarouEclipseSolaireMort.png|'''Werewolf''' when killed. }} ==Update History== *'''6 December 2021''' - [[v1.0.0]]b **'''Werewolf''' added. *'''8 December 2021''' - [[v1.0.0]]d **Now appears in the [[Tower Outskirts]]. *'''26 January 2022''' - [[v1.0.1]] **'''Werewolf''' removed. {{FoggyForest|[[Ent]]|Wave 9|Werewolf|Wave 11|[[Swamp Monster]]|Wave 12}} {{TowerOutskirts|[[Ghost Knight]]|Wave 12|Werewolf|Wave 13|[[Penumbras]]|Wave 15}} {{ZombieNavBox}} {{DISPLAYTITLE:Werewolf}}
